text:
Maya Chen: Quick design check 10 we're getting feedback that the rotate modals single red banner confuses people into thinking rotate always revokes. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/rotate-radio-presets
Samir Patel: Agreed. Suggest a radio group instead of a checkbox: Keep old key, Delay revoke (24h), Revoke now. Each option gets a one-line explainer. Default = Delay revoke.
Jamie Ortiz: Accessibility: radio selection should announce the explainer. Use aria-live on a tiny live region updated on change. If user picks Revoke now, announce the warning assertively and move focus to the warning region.
Kevin Liu: Backend: we already support a grace_window param. We can map radios to grace_window: keep=0 (no rotate?), delay=86400, revoke now=0 + revoke flag. I'll add an API param name "grace_window_seconds" and optional "revoke_immediately".
Aria Gomez: Copy suggestions: labels plain English: "Keep old key active", "Delay revoke (24 hours)", "Revoke now (immediate)". Explainers: "Allows old key to work while you roll out", "New key works now; old key disabled after 24h", "Old key stops working immediately; may cause outages".
Maya Chen: UX note: when user selects Delay revoke show a tiny tooltip: "Recommended for safe rollouts". For Revoke now require an extra confirm step: dialog asking to type the key name for high-risk orgs.
Samir Patel: Also propose an "Impact preview" badge that surfaces recent usage for that key (calls/day). If >threshold show a stronger warning. That data can be pulled from telemetry.
Jamie Ortiz: Keyboard & focus flow: modal opens -> focus on name input, tab to radio group. When selecting Revoke now, focus moves to the inline warning heading (focusable) which is announced. ESC closes and returns to the key row. We'll add details in the Figma prototype.
Kevin Liu: I'll implement API fields with feature flag and wire server-side guard for orgs above X calls/day to require confirm-phrase when revoke_immediately is true. I'll return telemetry in rotation preview endpoint: {"recent_calls": "12345"}.
Aria Gomez: Empty-state / docs: include a short checklist and two runnable snippets (curl + node) showing rotate with grace_window. Example curl: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/k_123/rotate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"grace_window_seconds":86400}'
```
Maya Chen: Can ops-bot open a single ticket capturing: radio UX + aria-live + impact preview badge + backend params + confirm-phrase guard + docs snippet? Include acceptance criteria.
ops-bot: Created ticket PROD-2101: "Rotate modal: radio presets (keep/delay/revoke), accessible live updates, impact preview, backend grace_window + revoke flag, confirm-phrase guard, docs snippets" assigned to @Jamie, @Kevin, @Aria. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROD-2101
Maya Chen: Great. Jamie please attach updated Figma with the radio interactions and focus flow before EOD so eng can pair on API mapping tomorrow. Thanks! :thumbsup:
